capabilities: Render question == answer lines as cards, including one-way, reverse and two-way variants (==>, <==, <=>)
Render cloze gaps from {{...}} and {{c1::...}} syntax, including answer|distractor pairs
Render multiple choice from (x)/( ) answer lines and dim completed task items
Play audio clips for phrases saved by the Atomus Mac app, with source on hover
Leave ==highlights==, code blocks, inline code, math and frontmatter untouched
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states it makes no network requests and only reads local files (Attachments/audio and .threads).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write flashcards as plain Markdown lines and see them rendered as cards inside notes.

relations.evidence: Atomus is a Mac app that saves phrases from anything you hear on your Mac (videos, podcasts, calls)

summary: Renders flashcards inline in notes from == Q/A lines, cloze gaps and multiple choice, and plays audio clips saved by the Atomus Mac app.
